name: input
useFor: Use Input for one line of text, email, numbers or a search. Put it in a Field with a label above and help or an error below; use InputGroup for a glyph or an action inside the field. Pass aria-invalid when the value fails.
constraints: A placeholder used as the label
source: Derived from the Hoplite website's lines and type (the site has no fields): the 32 percent line (--line-margin), the strong edge (--line), 14px controls
title: Input
description: A square 40px field: a 32 percent edge on the ground, 14px Satoshi with 12px sides, a slate placeholder; the edge turns strong under the pointer and ink on focus, orange when invalid.
